name: Can I live in my home during a whole-home remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during a whole-home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can live in your home during a whole-home remodel depends entirely on the project's scope and the areas being renovated. If the kitchen, main bathrooms, or critical utilities are out of commission for an extended period, or if there's significant dust and noise, it might be more practical and safer to arrange temporary accommodation. For smaller, phased remodels, it might be feasible to stay, but expect disruptions. We can discuss your specific project to determine the best approach for your family's comfort and safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Living in your home during a whole-home remodel depends on the project's scope; significant work on essential areas often makes temporary relocation more practical.
